runtime_boundary.loaded_object_limit: File hash and object-name equality are consistency checks. Real loaded-object authentication belongs to reviewed supervisor.admit; no marshal or metadata flag substitutes for it.
runtime_boundary.portable_limit: DurableStore refuses Windows. Bundled Windows NumPy by itself does not qualify POSIX motor/store.
runtime_boundary.no_replay_root: Store roots are request/decision-bound. Cross-root deletion/renaming is outside in-process power; qualified supervisor must enforce protected stable roots.

input_contract.extra_artifacts: All source:<role> raw bytes from SOURCE_PINS plus all reference bytes declared by consumer admission; array buffers raw f64le, row_ids/structure JSON. Artifact map exactly equals pinned map.
input_contract.request_scope: Exact declared family, not universal coverage. No compression by deduplicating labels. O02 must supply full admitted list when running actual family.
input_contract.decision_schema: F9_CONTROLLER_ROOT_DECISION_V1; request SHA and preparation manifest SHA, execution ID, specific single-use authorization, observation decision, supervisor adapter bytes and independent review reference
input_contract.cyclic_pin_resolution: coupling_template omits external_execution_authorization_reference; run_once inserts the actual ROOT decision bytes hash after decision/request checks. No authority is invented during preparation.
input_contract.source_locations: SOURCE_PINS paths are archival provenance; runtime copied modules must have same bytes. Runtime supplier engine directory must contain pinned RUNTIME_METADATA.json; guard must allow complete actual dependency set.

budgets.complete_grid_formula: N=(2^last_level+1)^3; max_solver_calls>=N cold cache; max_callback_calls>=N*S for S declared scenarios
budgets.inner_services: Each node coupling template requires explicit existing precision service caps/targets, checked by NodeContext and df482. No finite global accuracy certification is inferred.
budgets.local_wall_scope: From durable global run claim through processing; cooperative checks and post-return per-background deadline. Preflight/loader/external cleanup belong to independent supervisor total budget.
budgets.native_timeout_limit: A Python check cannot stop a hung native call. External watchdog remains required, absent here.
budgets.memory_store_limit: Names are explicit requested budgets, not enforcement measurements. max_record_bytes is enforced by existing DurableStore; full RAM/store quotas require supervisor. Large result publication can fail terminally; resource sufficiency not measured.

cache.background_key: scope_id + theta + engine_configuration_sha256 + runtime_sha256 + engine_sha256 + protocol_sha256 + supplier_reference
cache.node_key: Theta descriptor identity (including execution unit, consumer admission, callback, assembly/config) plus coupling admission and theta plan in stored claim identity
cache.across_scenarios: Background can hit same exact identity; likelihood always computed/stored with separate C/admission context. Original bytes and original 1/1 solver receipt immutable.
cache.across_failed_runs: No global run restart or substitution of roots/IDs. Read existing receipts; new ROOT decision for genuinely new work only.
cache.counts: Controller wraps callback entries/returns; supplier counts get_background entries/returns. Integrator receipt counts remain declared and are checked against terminal supplier counts.
